you'll stay average forever until
you master these 4 powerful
time rules

1. the 2-minute rule

if it takes less than
2 minutes, do it now.

2. eat the frog

the hardest task first,
before anything else.

3. the dead-time rule

queues, trains, waiting rooms:
learn something short.
